value: This extension addresses the common limitation in HTML5 video players that hide or restrict native playback speed controls. It provides users with comprehensive control over video consumption, allowing for quick adjustments to playback speed (accelerate, slow down) and instant rewinding or advancing of the video. Accessible via an on-screen indicator, mouse hover controls, or customizable keyboard shortcuts, the tool offers a personalized viewing experience, empowering users to consume content at their preferred pace and efficiently revisit specific moments.
